generate_elf_reloc_files: generate ELF object files for multiple architectures containing all relocation types
generate_coff_reloc_files: generate COFF object files for i386 and x86_64 architectures with all relocation types
generate_macho_reloc_files: generate MachO object files for i386, x86_64, and arm architectures with all relocation types
patch_elf_binary: patch ELF binary relocation entries with correct relocation type values
patch_coff_binary: patch COFF binary relocation entries with correct relocation type values
patch_macho_binary: patch MachO binary relocation entries with correct relocation type values
read_binary_fields: read binary fields from object files with endianness-aware parsing for ELF, COFF, and MachO formats
